"""プロファイル（.autoflow/profile.json）の型・既定値・検証と、承認の記録の型を定義する。

プロファイルは H0 で人が承認する。形を変えたら SCHEMA_VERSION を上げる（PROC-06）。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
from dataclasses import dataclass

from autoflow_kit import shape

SCHEMA_VERSION = 1
COMMAND_ID = r"[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*"
DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_SEC = 600
MAX_TIMEOUT_SEC = 3600
MAX_LIMIT = 100_000


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Command:
    id: str
    run: str
    timeout_sec: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Verify:
    commands: tuple[Command, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Paths:
    tests: tuple[str, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Risk:
    always_human: tuple[str, ...]
    high: tuple[str, ...]
    low: tuple[str, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Review:
    guide_files: tuple[str, ...]
    skip: tuple[str, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Limits:
    fix_attempts: int
    review_rounds: int
    max_scope_files: int
    large_diff_lines: int
    huge_diff_lines: int
    max_criteria: int


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Commit:
    trailers: tuple[str, ...]


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Profile:
    schema_version: int
    verify: Verify
    paths: Paths
    risk: Risk
    review: Review
    limits: Limits
    commit: Commit


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Approval:
    """profile-approval.json。承認したプロファイルの sha256 と、人の回答の原文。"""

    sha256: str
    who: str
    answer: str
    at: str


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class Field:
    """profile-schema.md に載せる項目の説明。"""

    key: str
    kind: str
    meaning: str


DEFAULT_TESTS = (
    "tests/**",
    "test/**",
    "**/__tests__/**",
    "**/*_test.go",
    "**/*.test.*",
    "**/*.spec.*",
    "**/test_*.py",
)
DEFAULT_RISK = Risk(
    always_human=(
        ".github/workflows/**",
        ".gitlab-ci.yml",
        ".circleci/**",
        "Jenkinsfile",
        "**/auth/**",
        "**/billing/**",
        "**/payment*/**",
        "**/migrations/**",
        "**/.env*",
        "**/*secret*",
        "**/*.pem",
        "**/*.key",
        ".autoflow/**",
        ".claude/**",
        "**/CLAUDE.md",
        "**/AGENTS.md",
        "**/REVIEW.md",
    ),
    high=(
        "**/package.json",
        "**/package-lock.json",
        "**/pnpm-lock.yaml",
        "**/yarn.lock",
        "**/go.mod",
        "**/go.sum",
        "**/pyproject.toml",
        "**/requirements*.txt",
        "**/poetry.lock",
        "**/uv.lock",
        "**/Cargo.toml",
        "**/Cargo.lock",
        "**/Gemfile*",
        "**/Dockerfile*",
        "**/docker-compose*.yml",
        "**/*.tf",
    ),
    low=("docs/**", "**/*.md"),
)
DEFAULT_REVIEW = Review(
    guide_files=(),
    skip=("**/*.lock", "**/package-lock.json", "**/pnpm-lock.yaml", "**/dist/**", "**/vendor/**", "**/*.min.js"),
)
DEFAULT_LIMITS = Limits(
    fix_attempts=3, review_rounds=3, max_scope_files=20, large_diff_lines=400, huge_diff_lines=1000, max_criteria=20
)
FIELDS = (
    Field("schema_version", "整数", f"プロファイルの形の版。今は {SCHEMA_VERSION}"),
    Field("verify.commands[].id", "文字列", "検査の名前（kebab-case）。証拠のログのファイル名になる"),
    Field("verify.commands[].run", "文字列", "リポジトリのルートで実行するシェルのコマンド。CI=1 を付けて実行する"),
    Field("verify.commands[].timeout_sec", "整数", f"時間の上限（秒、1〜{MAX_TIMEOUT_SEC}）"),
    Field("paths.tests", "glob の配列", "テストのファイル。不具合の修正で、最初に再現のテストだけを書く範囲"),
    Field("risk.always_human", "glob の配列", "常に人が差分を読むパス。計画で触ると H1、変更に含むと H3 で全文を読む"),
    Field("risk.high", "glob の配列", "変更に含むとリスクの段を high にするパス"),
    Field("risk.low", "glob の配列", "変更がこれとテストだけなら、リスクの段を low にするパス"),
    Field("review.guide_files", "パスの配列", "探索役と検証役に渡すレビューの指示（開始時の版を写す）"),
    Field("review.skip", "glob の配列", "レビューで指摘しないパス（生成物、lockfile）"),
    Field("limits.fix_attempts", "整数", "検査の失敗がこの回数続いたら H2"),
    Field("limits.review_rounds", "整数", "Important が残るレビューがこの回数続いたら H2"),
    Field("limits.max_scope_files", "整数", "計画の範囲がこのファイル数を超えたら H1"),
    Field("limits.large_diff_lines", "整数", "差分の行数がこれを超えたら、リスクの段を少なくとも medium にする"),
    Field("limits.huge_diff_lines", "整数", "差分の行数がこれを超えたら、リスクの段を high にする"),
    Field("limits.max_criteria", "整数", "計画の受け入れ条件の数の上限"),
    Field("commit.trailers", "文字列の配列", "コミットの文の最後に足す行（Co-Authored-By など）"),
)


def make_profile(commands: tuple[Command, ...], guide_files: tuple[str, ...]) -> Profile:
    """setup が検出した値と既定値から、承認の前の案を作る。"""
    return Profile(
        schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
        verify=Verify(commands),
        paths=Paths(DEFAULT_TESTS),
        risk=DEFAULT_RISK,
        review=Review(guide_files, DEFAULT_REVIEW.skip),
        limits=DEFAULT_LIMITS,
        commit=Commit(()),
    )


def digest(text: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(text.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()


def parse(value: object, problems: list[str]) -> Profile:
    data = shape.as_object(value, "", problems)
    shape.unknown_keys(data, ("schema_version", "verify", "paths", "risk", "review", "limits", "commit"), "", problems)
    version = data.get("schema_version")
    if version != SCHEMA_VERSION:
        problems.append(f"schema_version が {version!r} です。今の版は {SCHEMA_VERSION}。setup-new --force で作り直す")
    return Profile(
        schema_version=SCHEMA_VERSION,
        verify=_parse_verify(shape.as_object(data.get("verify"), "verify", problems), problems),
        paths=Paths(_globs(data, "paths", ("tests",), problems)[0]),
        risk=Risk(*_globs(data, "risk", ("always_human", "high", "low"), problems)),
        review=Review(*_globs(data, "review", ("guide_files", "skip"), problems)),
        limits=_parse_limits(shape.as_object(data.get("limits"), "limits", problems), problems),
        commit=Commit(*_globs(data, "commit", ("trailers",), problems)),
    )


def _parse_verify(data: dict[str, object], problems: list[str]) -> Verify:
    shape.unknown_keys(data, ("commands",), "verify", problems)
    commands = []
    for where, item in shape.objects(data, "commands", "verify", problems):
        shape.unknown_keys(item, ("id", "run", "timeout_sec"), where, problems)
        commands.append(
            Command(
                id=shape.text(item, "id", where, problems, pattern=COMMAND_ID),
                run=shape.filled(item, "run", where, problems),
                timeout_sec=shape.integer(item, "timeout_sec", where, problems, bounds=(1, MAX_TIMEOUT_SEC)),
            )
        )
    if not commands:
        problems.append("verify.commands が空です。検査コマンドが無いと証拠を作れない。1つ以上書く")
    for repeated in shape.duplicates(command.id for command in commands):
        problems.append(f"verify.commands の id {repeated!r} が重なっています")
    return Verify(tuple(commands))


def _globs(
    data: dict[str, object], key: str, names: tuple[str, ...], problems: list[str]
) -> tuple[tuple[str, ...], ...]:
    section = shape.as_object(data.get(key), key, problems)
    shape.unknown_keys(section, names, key, problems)
    return tuple(shape.texts(section, name, key, problems) for name in names)


def _parse_limits(data: dict[str, object], problems: list[str]) -> Limits:
    keys = ("fix_attempts", "review_rounds", "max_scope_files", "large_diff_lines", "huge_diff_lines", "max_criteria")
    shape.unknown_keys(data, keys, "limits", problems)
    values = [shape.integer(data, key, "limits", problems, bounds=(1, MAX_LIMIT)) for key in keys]
    limits = Limits(*values)
    if limits.large_diff_lines > limits.huge_diff_lines:
        problems.append("limits.large_diff_lines は limits.huge_diff_lines 以下にする")
    return limits


def parse_approval(value: object, problems: list[str]) -> Approval:
    data = shape.as_object(value, "", problems)
    shape.unknown_keys(data, ("sha256", "who", "answer", "at"), "", problems)
    return Approval(
        sha256=shape.text(data, "sha256", "", problems, pattern=r"[0-9a-f]{64}"),
        who=shape.text(data, "who", "", problems),
        answer=shape.filled(data, "answer", "", problems),
        at=shape.filled(data, "at", "", problems),
    )

"""人とサブエージェントが読む版（計画、プロファイル、レビューの結果、関所の理由、表）を Markdown で作る。"""

from __future__ import annotations

from autoflow_kit import contracts, policy, profile, render

TAG_LABELS = {policy.IMPORTANT: "Important", policy.NIT: "Nit", policy.PRE_EXISTING: "Pre-existing"}


def render_kinds() -> str:
    rows = [[f"`{kind.name}`", kind.label, "要る" if kind.repro else "—", kind.checks] for kind in policy.KINDS]
    return render.table(["種類", "意味", "再現のテスト", "確かめること"], rows)


def render_tiers() -> str:
    rows = [[f"`{tier.name}`", tier.depth, tier.human] for tier in policy.TIERS]
    return render.table(["段", "レビューの深さ", "H3 で人がすること"], rows)


def render_plan(plan: contracts.Plan, flow: policy.Flow) -> str:
    kind = policy.kind_of(plan.kind)
    criteria = [[item.id, item.text, item.check, item.run or render.MISSING] for item in plan.criteria]
    questions = [[item.question, item.default, item.impact] for item in plan.open_questions]
    parts = [
        "# 計画",
        "",
        f"- 種類: `{plan.kind}`（{kind.label}）",
        f"- ゴール: {plan.goal}",
        f"- 予測のリスクの段: `{flow.forecast_tier}`",
        f"- コミットの件名の案: {plan.commit_subject}",
        "",
        "## 組んだ手順",
        "",
        render.bullets(flow.steps),
        "",
        "## H1 に当たった条件",
        "",
        render.bullets([f"`{rule}` {policy.rule_text(rule)}" for rule in flow.h1_reasons]),
        "",
        "## 範囲",
        "",
        render.bullets([f"`{path}`" for path in plan.scope]),
        "",
        "## やらないこと",
        "",
        render.bullets(plan.non_goals),
        "",
        "## 受け入れ条件と確かめ方",
        "",
        render.table(["id", "条件", "確かめ方", "コマンド"], criteria),
        "",
        "## 依頼から決まらなかった値",
        "",
        render.table(["問い", "既定で使う値", "影響"], questions) if questions else render.bullets([]),
        "",
        "## 足す依存",
        "",
        render.bullets(plan.dependencies_to_add),
        "",
        "## 戻し方",
        "",
        plan.revert,
        "",
    ]
    if kind.repro:
        parts += ["## 再現と原因", "", f"- 再現のコマンド: `{plan.repro}`", f"- 原因の見立て: {plan.root_cause}", ""]
    return "\n".join(parts)


def render_profile(settings: profile.Profile) -> str:
    commands = [
        [command.id, f"`{command.run}`", render.number(command.timeout_sec)] for command in settings.verify.commands
    ]
    limits = settings.limits
    limit_rows = [
        ["検査の失敗が続いたら H2", render.number(limits.fix_attempts)],
        ["Important が残るレビューが続いたら H2", render.number(limits.review_rounds)],
        ["計画の範囲のファイル数がこれを超えたら H1", render.number(limits.max_scope_files)],
        ["差分の行数がこれを超えたら少なくとも medium", render.number(limits.large_diff_lines)],
        ["差分の行数がこれを超えたら high", render.number(limits.huge_diff_lines)],
        ["受け入れ条件の数の上限", render.number(limits.max_criteria)],
    ]
    return "\n".join(
        [
            "# プロファイル",
            "",
            "## 検査コマンド（verify が順に実行する）",
            "",
            render.table(["id", "コマンド", "上限（秒）"], commands),
            "",
            "## 常に人が差分を読むパス（risk.always_human）",
            "",
            render.bullets([f"`{path}`" for path in settings.risk.always_human]),
            "",
            "## リスクの段を high にするパス（risk.high）",
            "",
            render.bullets([f"`{path}`" for path in settings.risk.high]),
            "",
            "## これとテストだけなら low にするパス（risk.low）",
            "",
            render.bullets([f"`{path}`" for path in settings.risk.low]),
            "",
            "## テストのパス（paths.tests）",
            "",
            render.bullets([f"`{path}`" for path in settings.paths.tests]),
            "",
            "## レビュー",
            "",
            f"- 探索役と検証役に渡す指示: {', '.join(settings.review.guide_files) or render.MISSING}",
            f"- 指摘しないパス: {', '.join(settings.review.skip) or render.MISSING}",
            "",
            "## 上限",
            "",
            render.table(["条件", "値"], limit_rows),
            "",
            "## コミットの文の最後に足す行",
            "",
            render.bullets(settings.commit.trailers),
            "",
        ]
    )


def finding_line(item: contracts.Kept) -> str:
    """指摘の1行。プロンプトと報告書で同じ書き方にする。"""
    finding = item.finding
    others = f"（同じ種類の他の箇所: {', '.join(finding.other_locations)}）" if finding.other_locations else ""
    return (
        f"{item.id} [{TAG_LABELS.get(item.tag, item.tag)}] {finding.title} — `{finding.file}:{finding.line}`、"
        f"種類 {finding.bug_class}{others}"
    )


def render_review(result: contracts.ReviewResult) -> str:
    rows = [
        [
            item.id,
            TAG_LABELS.get(item.tag, item.tag),
            item.finding.title,
            f"{item.finding.file}:{item.finding.line}",
            item.finding.bug_class,
            f"{item.real_votes}/{item.voters}",
        ]
        for item in result.kept
    ]
    details = []
    for item in result.kept:
        details += [f"### {item.id} {item.finding.title}", "", item.finding.evidence, ""]
        if item.finding.other_locations:
            details += [render.bullets(item.finding.other_locations), ""]
    return "\n".join(
        [
            f"# レビュー ラウンド {result.round_no}",
            "",
            f"- 深さ: {result.depth}",
            f"- 差分: `{result.base[:12]}` → `{result.tree[:12]}`",
            f"- 票で落ちた候補: {', '.join(result.dropped) or render.MISSING}",
            "",
            render.table(["id", "重大度", "指摘", "場所", "バグの種類", "本物の票"], rows),
            "",
            *details,
        ]
    )


def render_gate(gate_id: str, reasons: tuple[str, ...], details: tuple[str, ...]) -> str:
    """H1・H2 の関所で人に見せる理由と選択肢。"""
    gate = policy.gate_of(gate_id)
    options = [[f"`{option.name}`", option.label, option.then] for option in gate.options]
    return "\n".join(
        [
            f"# {gate.id} {gate.label}",
            "",
            "## 当たった条件",
            "",
            render.bullets([f"`{rule}` {policy.rule_text(rule)}" for rule in reasons]),
            "",
            "## 今の状況",
            "",
            render.bullets(details),
            "",
            "## 選べること",
            "",
            render.table(["選択", "意味", "その後"], options),
            "",
        ]
    )

# プロファイルの項目

`.autoflow/profile.json` の項目である。形の版は `schema_version` で、今は 1 である。glob の `*` は `/` もまたぎ、`**/` で始まる glob はルートの直下のファイルにも当たる。

| 項目 | 型 | 意味 |
|---|---|---|
| `schema_version` | 整数 | プロファイルの形の版。今は 1 |
| `verify.commands[].id` | 文字列 | 検査の名前（kebab-case）。証拠のログのファイル名になる |
| `verify.commands[].run` | 文字列 | リポジトリのルートで実行するシェルのコマンド。CI=1 を付けて実行する |
| `verify.commands[].timeout_sec` | 整数 | 時間の上限（秒、1〜3600） |
| `paths.tests` | glob の配列 | テストのファイル。不具合の修正で、最初に再現のテストだけを書く範囲 |
| `risk.always_human` | glob の配列 | 常に人が差分を読むパス。計画で触ると H1、変更に含むと H3 で全文を読む |
| `risk.high` | glob の配列 | 変更に含むとリスクの段を high にするパス |
| `risk.low` | glob の配列 | 変更がこれとテストだけなら、リスクの段を low にするパス |
| `review.guide_files` | パスの配列 | 探索役と検証役に渡すレビューの指示（開始時の版を写す） |
| `review.skip` | glob の配列 | レビューで指摘しないパス（生成物、lockfile） |
| `limits.fix_attempts` | 整数 | 検査の失敗がこの回数続いたら H2 |
| `limits.review_rounds` | 整数 | Important が残るレビューがこの回数続いたら H2 |
| `limits.max_scope_files` | 整数 | 計画の範囲がこのファイル数を超えたら H1 |
| `limits.large_diff_lines` | 整数 | 差分の行数がこれを超えたら、リスクの段を少なくとも medium にする |
| `limits.huge_diff_lines` | 整数 | 差分の行数がこれを超えたら、リスクの段を high にする |
| `limits.max_criteria` | 整数 | 計画の受け入れ条件の数の上限 |
| `commit.trailers` | 文字列の配列 | コミットの文の最後に足す行（Co-Authored-By など） |

# 開発用の検査の設定。配布物（kit/）は Python 3.9 以上の標準ライブラリだけで動かす
[project]
name = "autoflow-kit"
version = "0.1.0"
requires-python = ">=3.9"
dependencies = []

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py39"
line-length = 120
src = ["kit/.autoflow", "scripts", "tests"]
extend-exclude = [".foundation", "docs/design/enforcement-matrix.md", "tests/fixtures"]

[tool.ruff.lint]
select = ["E", "W", "F", "I", "N", "UP", "B", "SIM", "RUF", "C90", "PTH", "T20", "PL", "TID", "BLE", "ARG", "ERA", "D100", "D104"]
ignore = [
  "C901",
  "RUF001", "RUF002", "RUF003",  # 日本語の全角記号を誤検出するため
  "PLR2004",                     # 終了コード 0/1/2 などの小さな定数を許す
]

[tool.ruff.lint.per-file-ignores]
"kit/.autoflow/autoflow_kit/cli.py" = ["T201"]
"scripts/*.py" = ["T201"]
"install.py" = ["T201"]

[tool.ruff.lint.flake8-tidy-imports]
ban-relative-imports = "all"

[tool.ruff.lint.mccabe]
max-complexity = 10

[tool.ruff.lint.pylint]
max-args = 6
max-branches = 12
max-returns = 6
max-statements = 50

[tool.ruff.lint.isort]
known-first-party = ["autoflow_kit"]

[tool.mypy]
python_version = "3.9"
strict = true
mypy_path = "kit/.autoflow"
files = ["kit/.autoflow/autoflow_kit", "kit/.autoflow/autoflow.py", "scripts", "tests", "install.py"]
exclude = ["tests/fixtures/"]
warn_unreachable = true

probes.description: 抑止コメントで lint を黙らせる
